The Meteorological Administration pointed out that the first wave of the northeast monsoon on the day after tomorrow, the high temperatures in the north will be slightly cooler and cooler, and the temperature will return on the weekend. There will be a stronger northeast monsoon next week, and the high temperatures in the north and Yihua will be more obvious, and the high temperatures will be as low as 27 degrees Celsius. In addition, Tropical Depression TD30 near Guam, which became a typhoon as soon as today, had no impact on Taiwan. There are 2 waves of Northeast monsoons in the coming week. The Meteorological Administration pointed out that it will be cloudy and clear all over the place tomorrow, with high temperatures and hot weather. Taipei will see 36 degrees. There will be showers in the mountains and southern areas in the afternoon. The first wave of the northeast monsoon will affect the day after tomorrow. The high temperatures in the north and Yilan will drop slightly to 30 degrees. There will be local short-term rain, especially in the northeast. The northeast monsoon will weaken at the weekend, and there will still be more moisture. In the north, eastern half and Hengchun, there will be local and continuous rain.

5def9a3b3cbf3327d5a5.en: Newtalk News pig farmers bear the transition costs to prevent African swine fever, and some people joke about "saving 200,000 yuan" online after bringing Chinese meat back to Taiwan. Recently, the community circulated the video, and the author claimed that his colleagues bought a large number of processed foods such as pork jerky and duck tongue when they traveled to China, but they were not found when they returned to Taiwan. As the incident was related to an employee of a company in Pingtung, the local black pig farmer was furious when he learned of it and asked the government to investigate and punish him severely. The reason why the news stepped on the pain points of pig farmers in central Pingtung is related to the changes made by the local black pig industry for epidemic prevention in recent years. Pingtung is an important black pig production area. In the past, six heaps of Hakka areas have used human surplus food to raise pigs for many years. This set of rearing methods that have lasted for hundreds of years has also allowed nearly purebred Taiwanese native black pigs to be preserved.
